content.text:
Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

You are implementing ONE issue in the Email OS Vue/Tauri client (repo = your worktree). Read first: PRODUCT.md (honest-state principle: pending/failed/partial/unknown must be visible and distinct), DESIGN.md (star/coverage notes, reader notes), src/components/ReaderView.vue (`starSummary`, `starCoverageDetail`, `data-test="reader-stars"`), and grep src/ + tests/ for `reader-stars` and the star summary helpers to see tests that pin the current behaviour.

## Shared rules (all reader-review tasks)
- Context: we compared our conversation reader against a Superhuman screenshot. Under the subject Superhuman shows only a useful one-liner; ours always shows a status line "Not starred — Effective star values known for 3 of 3 cached messages. Pending intent is not provider confirmation." even when the result is the unremarkable one, adding noise right under the subject.
- Stay on-brand per PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md: terse, honest, precise. Do NOT hide truth: partial / unknown / pending star coverage must remain visible with precise wording. Message content text-interpolated only.
- Keep every existing `data-test` attribute and aria-label; update tests in tests/ and src that your change legitimately affects (explain each in the report). Do NOT edit DESIGN.md or PRODUCT.md — put design-doc notes in your final report.
- Other agents are changing the same files in parallel on separate branches (toolbar→header, collapsed snippets, body type/measure, Details/focus-ring dedupe, active-card style, recent-mail filter). Keep your diff MINIMAL and localized; no reformatting.
- Setup: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Verify with `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` (full suite; report honestly incl. pre-existing failures).
- Preview: `pnpm dev --port <PORT> --strictPort` (in-memory fixture workspace). Use mcp__t3-code__preview_* tools (load via ToolSearch), resize 1280x800, press Enter on the focused first row to open "Fixture thread 1: weekly status". Stop dev server and close preview tab when done.
- Evidence: save PNGs under the evidence dir below (mkdir -p). BEFORE (base commit) and AFTER at 1280x800 via preview_snapshot save=true (copy screenshotPath to named files). If blurry, retry.
- Commit on your worktree's branch (no push, no PR). End the commit message with: `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Final report (brief): branch + head SHA, files changed, what you did, tests run/results, evidence absolute paths, DESIGN.md notes, anything you couldn't do.

## Your issue: P2 – The status line shows no news
- Show the star line under the subject ONLY when there is something to report: (a) the conversation IS starred (show a quiet "Starred" with the coverage qualifier only if coverage is incomplete), (b) coverage is partial/unknown for any message, or (c) a star change is pending/unconfirmed. When all values are known and the conversation is not starred and nothing is pending: render nothing visible (but you may keep a visually-hidden status for AT if tests/ARIA rely on it — decide by reading the code and say why).
- When starred and fully known: keep it as short as possible (e.g. "Starred"); do not append the full coverage sentence — leave the full coverage text in the title/visually-hidden detail as today.
- Partial/unknown/pending wording stays exactly as precise as today (reuse existing helper strings; only the visibility rules change). Make the visible line use the existing quiet style (`.reader-context-note`) and cap its measure (it is currently uncapped, e.g. `max-width: 80ch`).
- Test all branches: not starred+complete (hidden), starred+complete, partial coverage, pending. The fixtures may only cover some; for the others temporarily tweak the fixture/browser-fake in a scratch edit, screenshot, and REVERT the fixture change before committing (commit must contain only real changes + tests).
- Evidence dir: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-sofianebebert-workspace-worktrees-email-os-t3-8289bc5f/c76d33d1-bfb7-485b-a7f9-1da77be42a31/scratchpad/evidence/p2-star-line . PORT: 5205. Required: before/after at 1280x800 for default fixture (line hidden), plus after screenshots for starred, partial-coverage and pending states.

The one place we deliberately go our own way is state: pending, failed, partial and outcome-unknown states are always visible in their own form (*"Honest state over smooth feel"*, PRODUCT.md). A quiet surface must never hide what happened.
DESIGN.md:194:1. **Split header.** Done (2026-11-07 header pass). The header is one borderless 78px strip inside the list column (the rail and contact pane span its height). It has a Graphite hamburger (Destinations navigator) centered 23px in, split tabs on the 50px inset (16px, active Paper White, inactive Smoke, 11px Ash count 4px after the label, 18px apart), and right-hand glyphs on the 32px pitch: Back (when there is history), Reminders (fixture only), the Starred-only toggle, Commands and Search. There is no brand text, no visible h1 while a tab is active, and no bordered chips. Glyphs are local inline SVG (`HeaderGlyph.vue`).
DESIGN.md:195:   - The context h1 stays in the accessibility tree. It is shown on screen, styled like an active tab, only when no rendered tab is active (Cached Done, Starred, Search, the reader, an open drawer).
DESIGN.md:196:   - The status line is removed. The inbox count is on the active tab; loaded counts were dropped as duplicates of the list. Selection count stays in SelectionBar, plus a visually hidden polite announcement. The pending count is covered by row "Pending…", the action notice and Activity. The Shift+U hint is in the Commands palette. The command error is its own alert line beside the action notice in the list column's bottom dock (gap 13). The read-only hint and the Unread-only/Starred-only filter states stay visible in words in the header.
DESIGN.md:199:   Remaining: a compose glyph was deliberately not added, because there is no compose capability beyond local drafts in the Drafts drawer; decide whether "New local draft" earns a header slot. (The aggregate pending count now lives on the Activity rail badge, and the tab line is calibrated against the rail's home circle: both are centered 42px down; see gap 2.)
DESIGN.md:202:   - **Inkwell pill:** a 30px pill (the capture measures ~30px, not 28px) holds Starred (Gmail), Cached Done, Provider mail and Cached Trash (Gmail) as 16px glyphs on 28px hit targets at a 28px pitch. Its first glyph is centered on the first list line.
DESIGN.md:206:   - **Activity badge:** a small Amber Notice count on the Activity glyph shows unresolved operations, i.e. `queued`/`applying` plus `outcome_unknown`. It is derived from the activity rows the drawer already lists, with no new read. The digit is `aria-hidden`; the words ("2 operations pending", "1 operation with outcome unknown", or "3 operations unresolved: 2 pending, 1 outcome unknown") are the button's `aria-describedby` and are appended to its title. The badge disappears at zero.
DESIGN.md:207:   - **Glyphs:** local inline SVG in `PaneGlyph.vue` (Starred reuses HeaderGlyph's star). The rail sits at z-index 20 (above the row popover at 6, below drawers at 30).
DESIGN.md:226:13. **In-flow bars.** Done (polish pass). Every bar is borderless Body type with its text on the 50px content inset and 6px block padding. The lines that come and go with triage keys (the Selection bar, the single-slot Action notice and the command-error alert) now live in a bottom dock of the list column (`.list-dock`) instead of above the list, so x, e and z never move a row. Measured at 1280×800 (Gmail preview): the first row stays at y=126 (real clock) or y=78 (Today clock) through x, x, Clear, e and z; before, it moved 126 → 186.9 → 162.8 → 156. The dock keeps one 36px line reserved and grows upward into the list viewport (selection: 56px). If that shrink would clip the focused row, the list scrolls just enough to keep it whole. The static context lines (Starred/Done coverage, draft-close recovery) stay above the list, because they belong to the destination rather than to an action. The reader's selection-scope note is a borderless line in the reader.
DESIGN.md:257:- **Amber Notice** (`warning`): pending, outcome unknown, local-only, expired-undo and partial states.
DESIGN.md:333:- **Activity badge:** an Amber Notice count of unresolved operations (pending plus outcome unknown), named in words by the button's description and title.
DESIGN.md:359:- **Above the list (static lines):** Starred/Done coverage notes and the draft-close recovery banner, which belong to the destination or to a pending recovery rather than to the last keystroke.
DESIGN.md:367:- **Do** show every pending, partial, failed and outcome-unknown state in words, in Amber Notice or Coral Fault, where the user is already looking.
DESIGN.md:370:- **Do** name each action once, in sentence case, on every surface (row glyph, selection bar, reader, Activity, action notice, palette): "Mark done" / "Mark not done" (E / Shift+E), "Mark read" / "Mark unread", "Star" / "Unstar". Counted forms keep the verb: "Mark 3 done". Destinations keep their proper names (Inbox, Done, Starred, Trash, Provider mail, Activity) after "Go to". "Archive" is the provider-side effect, never a label; it survives only as a palette search alias.
